newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-PAKISTAN WIN TOSS, MAKE SRI LANKA BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN WIN TOSS, MAKE SRI LANKA BAT.

text.p: Pakistan won the toss and elected to field in the first match of the sixth Asia Cup tournament at Colombo's R.Premadasa stadium on Monday.

Sri Lanka - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Mavan Atapattu, Aravinda de Silva, Roshan Mahanama, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Ruwan Kalpage, Kumar Dharmasena, Chaminda Vaas, Sajeeva de Silva, Muttiah Muralitharan.
Pakistan - Rameej Raja, Saeed Anwar, Shahid Afridi, Amir Sohail, Salim Malik, Injman-ul-Haq, Moin Khan, Saqlain Mushtaq, Arshad Khan, Aquib Jawed, Kabir Khan.
